_comment: OpenPipeline rule set for macOS security events from the agent (log.source macos:unified_log / macos:endpoint_security). Applied by openpipeline/apply-macos-security.py: creates/updates the custom logs pipeline by customId, inserts the route BEFORE the OpenTelemetry Host Monitoring route (first-match routing), and copies the extension's Smartscape linking stage so records still attach to the OTEL_HOST. Processing follows the Windows/auditd pipelines' Semantic Dictionary contract: event.provider, event.category/type/outcome, user.name, source.ip, process.*; the data-extraction stage emits security events for the notable subset.

entry.description: macOS security events & logs from the Claude Code OTel agent (unified log + optional Endpoint Security) -> Semantic Dictionary + security events

value.displayName: macOS security (unified log + Endpoint Security) -> Semantic Dictionary

processors.description: STAGE 0: stamp event.provider on every macOS record and normalise the executable basename, so coverage does not depend on a family processor below claiming the record.

dql.script:
fieldsAdd event.provider = coalesce(event.provider, if(log.source == "macos:endpoint_security", "macos.endpoint_security", else: "macos.unified_log"))
| fieldsAdd process.name = coalesce(process.name, arrayLast(splitString(process.executable.path, "/")))
| fieldsAdd host.os.type = "darwin"

processors.description: Open Directory / AccountPolicy authentication results (local login, SecureToken, password verification). Outcome from the message wording.

dql.script:
fieldsAdd event.category = "authentication"
| fieldsAdd event.type = "authentication"
| fieldsAdd event.outcome = if(contains(content, "Failed") or contains(content, "invalid credentials") or contains(content, "Failure") or contains(content, "denied"), "failure", else: if(contains(content, "Success") or contains(content, "Succeeded") or contains(content, "Allowed: "), "success"))
| fieldsAdd authentication.method = if(contains(content, "SecureToken"), "securetoken", else: "opendirectory")

processors.description: OpenSSH logins: Accepted/Failed <method> for [invalid user] <user> from <ip> port <port>.

dql.script:
fieldsAdd event.category = "authentication"
| fieldsAdd event.type = "authentication"
| fieldsAdd event.outcome = if(startsWith(content, "Accepted"), "success", else: if(startsWith(content, "Failed") or contains(content, "Invalid user") or contains(content, "authentication failure"), "failure"))
| parse content, "LD ' for ' ('invalid user ' LD:tmp_invalid)? WORD:tmp_user ' from ' IPADDR:tmp_ip ' port ' INT:tmp_port"
| fieldsAdd user.name = tmp_user, source.ip = tmp_ip, source.port = tmp_port, authentication.protocol = "ssh"
| fieldsAdd user.exists = if(isNotNull(tmp_invalid), false, else: true)
| fieldsRemove tmp_invalid, tmp_user, tmp_ip, tmp_port

processors.description: sudo: successful elevation is a process start with the target user and command; 'incorrect password attempt(s)', 'a password is required' (non-interactive sudo without cached credentials) and 'NOT in sudoers' are authentication failures. Matches only the audit line ('<user> : …'); sudo's own debug chatter stays unclassified.

dql.script:
parse content, "WORD:tmp_user ' : ' LD:tmp_rest"
| fieldsAdd tmp_fail = contains(content, "incorrect password") or contains(content, "NOT in sudoers") or contains(content, "command not allowed") or contains(content, "a password is required") or contains(content, "authentication failure")
| fieldsAdd event.category = if(tmp_fail, "authentication", else: "process")
| fieldsAdd event.type = if(tmp_fail, "authentication", else: "start")
| fieldsAdd event.outcome = if(tmp_fail, "failure", else: "success")
| fieldsAdd user.name = tmp_user
| parse content, "LD 'USER=' WORD:tmp_target"
| parse content, "LD 'COMMAND=' LD:tmp_cmd"
| parse content, "LD 'TTY=' WORD:tmp_tty"
| fieldsAdd user.target.name = tmp_target, process.command_line = tmp_cmd, process.tty = tmp_tty, event.action = "sudo"
| fieldsRemove tmp_user, tmp_rest, tmp_fail, tmp_target, tmp_cmd, tmp_tty

processors.description: authd authorization rights: 'Succeeded authorizing right X by client Y' / 'Failed to authorize right X'.

dql.script:
fieldsAdd event.category = "authentication"
| fieldsAdd event.type = "authorization"
| fieldsAdd event.outcome = if(startsWith(content, "Succeeded"), "success", else: if(startsWith(content, "Failed") or contains(content, "denied"), "failure"))
| parse content, "LD 'right ' SQS:tmp_right"
| parse content, "LD 'by client ' SQS:tmp_client"
| fieldsAdd authorization.right = tmp_right, process.client.path = tmp_client
| fieldsRemove tmp_right, tmp_client

processors.description: User/group lifecycle via sysadminctl and dscl. Matches only messages about users, records, passwords, groups or admin rights; the tools' XPC/connection chatter stays unclassified (and emits no security event).
processors.matcher: (process.name == "sysadminctl" or process.name == "dscl" or macos.subsystem == "com.apple.sysadminctl") and (matchesValue(content, "*user*") or matchesValue(content, "*User*") or matchesValue(content, "*record*") or matchesValue(content, "*password*") or matchesValue(content, "*Password*") or matchesValue(content, "*group*") or matchesValue(content, "*admin*"))

dql.script:
fieldsAdd event.category = "iam"
| fieldsAdd event.type = if(contains(content, "Creating") or contains(content, "create"), "user_created", else: if(contains(content, "Deleting") or contains(content, "delete"), "user_deleted", else: if(contains(content, "password") or contains(content, "Password"), "password_changed", else: "user_changed")))
| fieldsAdd event.outcome = if(contains(content, "fail") or contains(content, "Fail") or contains(content, "error"), "failure", else: "success")
| parse content, "LD 'user record for ' WORD:tmp_target"
| fieldsAdd user.target.name = tmp_target
| fieldsAdd user.target.admin = contains(content, "admin")
| fieldsRemove tmp_target

processors.description: Gatekeeper / system policy assessments and XProtect detections. Denied assessments and detections are 'malware'/'intrusion_detection' style outcomes; everything else is configuration telemetry.
processors.matcher: macos.subsystem == "com.apple.syspolicy" or macos.subsystem == "com.apple.XProtect" or process.name == "XProtectRemediator" or process.name == "XProtectBehaviorService"

dql.script:
fieldsAdd tmp_block = contains(content, "denied") or contains(content, "blocked") or contains(content, "detected") or contains(content, "remediat") or contains(content, "malware")
| fieldsAdd event.category = if(tmp_block, "malware", else: "configuration")
| fieldsAdd event.type = if(macos.subsystem == "com.apple.syspolicy", "gatekeeper", else: "xprotect")
| fieldsAdd event.outcome = if(tmp_block, "failure", else: "success")
| parse content, "LD ' for ' LD:tmp_path ':'"
| fieldsAdd file.path = tmp_path
| fieldsRemove tmp_block, tmp_path

processors.description: TCC privacy decisions (camera, mic, Full Disk Access, screen recording...).

dql.script:
fieldsAdd event.category = "configuration"
| fieldsAdd event.type = "privacy_access"
| fieldsAdd event.outcome = if(contains(content, "denied") or contains(content, "Denying"), "failure", else: "success")
| parse content, "LD 'service=' WORD:tmp_service"
| parse content, "LD 'identifier=' LD:tmp_id ','"
| fieldsAdd tcc.service = tmp_service, process.identifier = tmp_id
| fieldsRemove tmp_service, tmp_id

processors.description: Launch/background items (persistence), firewall decisions, installer and software update activity.
processors.matcher: macos.subsystem == "com.apple.backgroundtaskmanagement" or macos.subsystem == "com.apple.Firewall" or process.name == "socketfilterfw" or process.name == "installer" or process.name == "pkgd" or macos.subsystem == "com.apple.softwareupdate"

dql.script:
fieldsAdd event.category = if(macos.subsystem == "com.apple.backgroundtaskmanagement", "persistence", else: if(macos.subsystem == "com.apple.Firewall" or process.name == "socketfilterfw", "network", else: "package"))
| fieldsAdd event.type = "change"
| fieldsAdd event.outcome = if(contains(content, "fail") or contains(content, "Fail") or contains(content, "error") or contains(content, "denied"), "failure", else: "success")

processors.description: Endpoint Security (eslogger) records: event family from the top-level 'event' object key; process identity from the ES process record.

dql.script:
parse content, "JSON:tmp_es"
| fieldsAdd es.action_type = tmp_es[action_type]
| fieldsAdd es.event_name = if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][exec]), "exec", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][exit]), "exit", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][fork]), "fork", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][open]), "open", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][create]), "create", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][unlink]), "unlink", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][rename]), "rename", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][setextattr]), "setextattr", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][mount]), "mount", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][unmount]), "unmount", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][login_login]), "login_login", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][login_logout]), "login_logout", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][lw_session_login]), "lw_session_login", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][lw_session_logout]), "lw_session_logout", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][lw_session_lock]), "lw_session_lock", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][lw_session_unlock]), "lw_session_unlock", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][openssh_login]), "openssh_login", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][openssh_logout]), "openssh_logout", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][screensharing_attach]), "screensharing_attach", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][screensharing_detach]), "screensharing_detach", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][su]), "su", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][sudo]), "sudo", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][authentication]), "authentication", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][xp_malware_detected]), "xp_malware_detected", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][xp_malware_remediated]), "xp_malware_remediated", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][btm_launch_item_add]), "btm_launch_item_add", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][btm_launch_item_remove]), "btm_launch_item_remove", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][profile_add]), "profile_add", else: if(isNotNull(tmp_es[event][profile_remove]), "profile_remove", else: "other")))))))))))))))))))))))))))))
| fieldsAdd event.category = if(in(es.event_name, {"exec", "exit", "fork"}), "process", else: if(in(es.event_name, {"open", "create", "unlink", "rename", "setextattr"}), "file", else: if(in(es.event_name, {"login_login", "login_logout", "lw_session_login", "lw_session_logout", "lw_session_lock", "lw_session_unlock", "openssh_login", "openssh_logout", "screensharing_attach", "screensharing_detach", "su", "sudo", "authentication"}), "authentication", else: if(in(es.event_name, {"xp_malware_detected", "xp_malware_remediated"}), "malware", else: if(in(es.event_name, {"btm_launch_item_add", "btm_launch_item_remove", "profile_add", "profile_remove"}), "persistence", else: "host")))))
| fieldsAdd event.type = es.event_name
| fieldsAdd process.command_line = if(es.event_name == "exec", toString(tmp_es[event][exec][args]))
| fieldsAdd process.executable.path = coalesce(tmp_es[event][exec][target][executable][path], process.executable.path)
| fieldsAdd process.parent.pid = tmp_es[process][ppid]
| fieldsAdd process.name = arrayLast(splitString(process.executable.path, "/"))
| fieldsRemove tmp_es

processors.description: Emit a security event (in addition to the log record, which still lands in Grail) for the notable subset: failed authentication/authorization, failed sudo, account lifecycle, Gatekeeper/XProtect blocks, persistence changes and Endpoint Security malware events. Same provider constant as processing STAGE 0, so detections can read either the log or the event.
processors.matcher: (event.category == "authentication" and event.outcome == "failure") or event.category == "iam" or event.category == "malware" or event.category == "persistence"
